reason: Anchors stopped the rolling-range explosion but nearly every global block still matured, so block count rather than a genuine onset continued to own cadence. The family has positive raw expectancy but not enough to survive authentic friction.

causal_anatomy.harmonized_width_definition: opening width above 0.80 and at or below 1.00 times the prior same-block median, with formation efficiency at or below 0.25
causal_anatomy.interpretation: A moderately compressed, two-sided opening appears to preserve financing through both directions and all three observed months. The failure branch still loses; this is a successor hypothesis, not a promoted result.

successor_constraint: Permission must be decided from prior same-block opening history before the probe. Test a narrow harmony/expanded-balance neighbourhood and require a failed probe to rotate through opening VWAP with an opposite completed five-minute majority before reversal entry.
